create.capangel_explanation: A CapAngel is a trusted person you assign to your capsule. If for some reason you cannot access your account or if the countdown ends but you haven't opened the capsule, your CapAngel can help manage or open it for you. If you don't assign one, your capsule will remain sealed until the timer runs out, and if you lose access to your account, no one will be able to retrieve it.

detail.privacy_content:
Kapsely (we, us, or our) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and share your personal information.

1. Information We Collect: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, and any content you upload to our time capsules.

2. How We Use Your Information: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you, and ensure the security of our platform.

3. Information Sharing: We do not share your personal information with third parties except as necessary to provide our services or comply with the law.

4. Your Rights: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time.

2. User Content: You are responsible for any content you upload to Kapsely. You must not upload content that is illegal, offensive, or infringes on the rights of others.

3. Intellectual Property: All content and technology in Kapsely are the property of the Company or its licensors.

4. Limitation of Liability: Kapsely shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the app.

5. Changes to Terms: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time.
